reuse.why: Calls the existing pieces (assertNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount, handleSyncResponse, post/BankSyncError) but no shared link/download routine exists and none is created, so the per-provider flow is re-copied.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, differing only in names and the server URL.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts it: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts, account type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on the provider, though it edits two desktop-client files in a server-only change (needed only to satisfy the Record<BankSyncProviders> typing).

maintainability.why: A sixth copy of the link flow and another copy of the download flow; any fix to linking or downloading must be repeated per provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link/download abstraction exists to bypass; existing helpers are called.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount (accounts/app.ts) and downloadFintegraTransactions (accounts/sync.ts) are open copies with only names changed, not disguised.
